import numpy as np

im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
h,w,_=im.shape

# masks by heuristics
masks={
'blue':(B>R*1.18)&(B>G*1.12)&(B>60),
'yellow':(R>100)&(G>90)&(R>B*1.4)&(G>B*1.3)&(abs(R-G)<100),
'dark':(R+G+B<90),
'verydark':(R+G+B<40),
'brown':(R>G*1.15)&(G>B*1.05)&(R>60),
'bright':(R+G+B>600),
}
# connected comps via scipy
from scipy import ndimage
for name,m in masks.items():
  lab,n=ndimage.label(m)
  objs=ndimage.find_objects(lab)
  comps=[]
  for i,sl in enumerate(objs,1):
    if sl:
      area=np.sum(lab[sl]==i)
      if area>=20:
       yy,xx=np.where(lab==i)
       comps.append((area,(xx.min(),yy.min(),xx.max()+1,yy.max()+1),(xx.mean(),yy.mean())))

  print('\\n',name,'total',m.sum(),'comps',len(comps))

  s+=ch
 print(s)
